噬界之威（噬界之威（第22页）一根拇指粗细的木质尖刺在法杖顶端凝聚成型，激射而出。尖刺在空气中拉出一道翠绿色的残影，速度快到肉眼几乎无法捕捉。它撞上靶柱表面的防护符文，炸开一团刺目的绿光。轰！监测晶石板上的数字疯狂跳动。伊森走到晶石板前，低头看了一眼。在自己禁用被动的情况下，荆棘之刺，基础威力是2度。91木属性亲和加成，威力翻到382度。可晶石板上显示的最终威力是240度。伊森抬起法杖，又朝靶柱释放了一道巨木突刺。伊森一道接一道地释放戏法，晶石板上的数字不断跳动。每一道戏法经过增幅，威力全部翻了50倍以上。他停下手，走到晶石板前，把上面记录的数值从头到尾看了一遍。所有戏法经过噬界增幅，威力全部翻了50倍。三级巫器的加成确实恐怖。他握着法杖又释放了几道戏法，靶柱表面的防护符文被轰得明灭不定，监测晶石板上的数字不断跳动。可问题也在这里。伊森能感觉到，魔力在涌入杖身时有一层无形的阻滞。那感觉像在用一根水管往水缸里灌水，水管够粗，但接口处的阀门只拧开了三分之一。魔力能过去，也能被增幅，但流速和总量都被那个接口限制住了。不过这不是噬界的问题，而是他的问题。噬界是三级巫器，杖身内部的能量回路、符文结构等，全是为巫师那个层次的使用者设计的。他一个三等学徒拿着这柄法杖，就像小孩抡大锤。锤子本身能砸碎石头，但他抡不了几下就胳膊发酸。勉强能用，却远不到发挥真正威力的地步。伊森把法杖横在身前，指尖从杖身上那两个由木质纤维自行编织的字符上轻轻划过。“噬界”两个字微微凸起，触感温润。他闭上眼，将精神力集中到极限，再次往法杖里注入魔力。这次的魔力输出比之前任何一次都要大。杖身内部的木质纤维在同一瞬间全部亮了起来，深青色的光芒从杖心涌出，沿着纤维纹路朝杖头蔓延的速度明显快了几分。杖身表面那些层叠的翠绿色光纹从杖底亮到杖顶，整根法杖在他手中微微震颤。一道荆棘之刺在杖顶凝聚成型，激射而出。尖刺划破空气时发出的不再是尖锐的啸声，而是一声沉闷的音爆。它撞上靶柱表面的防护符文，炸开的绿光将整个试验场照得如同白昼。监测晶石板上的数字疯狂跳动。1210度。伊森收回魔力，法杖上的光纹缓缓黯淡下去。基础数值被他自己提上去了一点。能提，却提不了太多。他现在的精神力强度和魔力总量，撑死了也只能把戏法的初始威力往上推这么一截。再往上加，魔力输出的稳定度就会下降，增幅效率反而会降低。等晋升正式巫师，精神海完成辐射化改造，魔力输出量和稳定性都会发生质变。到那时候，噬界的真正威力才能被一点点发掘出来。当然，这还没有计算被动增幅以及戏法的叠加下的威力。

> Chapter 165 The Power of Devouring the World (Page 1)
The Power of Devouring Worlds (The Power of Devouring Worlds (page 22)) A wooden spike as thick as a thumb condensed and formed on the top of the staff and shot out. The spikes pulled out an emerald green afterimage in the air, so fast that it was almost impossible to catch it with the naked eye. It hit the protective runes on the surface of the target pillar and exploded into a ball of dazzling green light. Boom! The numbers on the monitoring crystal board were beating wildly. Ethan walked to the crystal board and looked down. Before he disabled his passive In this case, the basic power of Thorns is 2 degrees. With 91 wood affinity bonus, the power is increased to 382 degrees. The final power shown on the crystal stone board is 240 degrees. Ethan raised his staff and released another giant wood thrust towards the target pillar. The numbers on the crystal stone board kept jumping. After each magic trick was increased, the power was increased by more than 50 times. I read the values recorded above from beginning to end. The power of all the tricks increased by 50 times. The bonus of the third-level magic weapon was really terrifying. He held the staff and released several more tricks. The protective runes on the surface of the target column were flickering, and the numbers on the monitoring crystal plate kept beating. But there was also a problem. Ethan could feel that there was an invisible blockage when the magic power flowed into the staff. Using a water pipe to fill the water tank, the water pipe is thick enough, but the valve at the interface is only opened one-third. The magic power can pass through and can be amplified, but the flow rate and total amount are limited by the interface. However, this is not the problem of the Devouring World, but his problem. The energy circuit and rune structure inside the staff are all designed for users of the wizard level. He is a third-class apprentice holding this handle. The staff was like a child wielding a sledgehammer. The hammer itself could break stones, but his arms became sore after just a few swings. It was barely usable, but far from being able to exert its true power. Ethan held the staff horizontally in front of him, and lightly traced the two characters woven from the wood fibers on the staff. The word "Eating World" was slightly raised and felt warm. He closed his eyes, concentrated his mental power to the limit, and injected magic into the staff again. This time the magic output was greater than before. All the wooden fibers inside the staff lit up at the same moment, and the dark cyan light gushed out from the core of the staff, spreading significantly faster along the fiber lines. The cascading emerald green light patterns on the surface of the staff shone from the bottom to the top of the staff. A thorn of thorns formed at the top of the staff and shot out. It was no longer a sharp whistle, but a dull sonic boom. It hit the protective rune on the surface of the target pillar, and the green light illuminated the entire test site. The number on the monitoring crystal board jumped wildly. The light pattern on the staff slowly dimmed. It could be improved, but not by much. If you are exhausted, you can only push the initial power of the magic up so much. If you increase it further, the stability of the magic output will decrease, and the increase efficiency will decrease. When the spiritual sea completes the radiation transformation, the magic output and stability will change qualitatively. At that time, the real power of the Devouring World can be gradually discovered. Of course, this does not include the power of the passive increase and the superposition of the magic.
